text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a few weeks before the Japan Cup. 
I was brainstorming race strategies with 
Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Renowned Umamusume have once again 
announced their entry into this year's 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, representing the 7-time turf GⅠ 
winning Umamusume Kitasan Black's 
generation—last year's Japan Cup champion, 
Cheval Grand."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown, victor of an overseas G1. 
Satono Diamond, who won the Arima Kinen 
while still in the Classic tier—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though yet without a GⅠ win, Sounds of 
Earth continues to run steadily in the 
Twinkle Series... Amidst all these fierce 
contenders—"
choice_data_list: ――Kiseki especially is unpredictable
――Kiseki especially is unpredictable

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...A-All right! We did it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming a rarely seen, exceedingly 
heavy track at the Kikuka Sho, she pulled 
off a magnificent victory from behind. 
Yet, her running style remains utterly 
versatile—
choice_data_list:
Therefore, it's hard to set a fixed 
strategy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So, we decided to first run a simulated 
match to solidify the strategy in our 
heads.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—It is a true honor to run alongside you, 
Ai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Same here, thank you for agreeing to do 
it! Looking forward to working with you, 
Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Bouquetd'or. One 
generation younger than Almond Eye, she's 
a gentle Umamusume who deeply values 
harmony.
choice_data_list:
Sorry to jump right in, but let me start 
as a Late Surger!

Sorry to jump right in, but I'll start as 
a Late Surger, please!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(—Rather than the Kikuka Sho, maybe last 
year's Open race would be a better 
reference. Kiseki-chan was in the rear 
pack...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I have to stay mindful of my path when 
making a move. Kiseki-chan will surely 
come from the far outside—)
choice_data_list: —...Start!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, I had a bad start again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once Almond Eye messed up a start, she 
fell behind right out of the gate in 
consecutive races. She faced this exact 
same challenge right after her debut—
choice_data_list:
Did you overdo the mental rehearsal in the 
gate?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I felt like I had to deal with 
Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to win" is getting ahead of 
yourself again, isn't it? Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye doesn't have a wealth of race 
experience yet. It's only natural that 
she'd overthink things in her pursuit of 
victory.
choice_data_list:
(I need to figure out a clear weapon for 
her before the big race...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Look, over there...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. Would you mind taking turns 
soon?
choice_data_list: (Gentildonna...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, s-s-s-so sorry! Our time slot is 
already up, isn't it? Excuse me—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You. Your muscle balance seems slightly 
biased to the right.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, your form is faltering... I 
recommend increasing the number of sets 
for your lower-left body training.
choice_data_list: (Huh? She's surprisingly nice—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Muscle hypertrophy without purpose only 
hinders your running. —Take this moment to 
reflect upon your form once more.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ghk!! I-I-I'm so sorry...! Thank you so 
very much............!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Harsh words.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, Gentildonna is—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her achievements are astounding. Not only 
did she capture the Triple Tiara, but 
right after that, in the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing Orfevre, who reigned at the 
pinnacle a generation above, she achieved 
the first victory in history as a 
Classic-tier Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words... they achieved a great 
feat from a position similar to Almond 
Eye's right now.
choice_data_list: We'd like some advice too.
We want some advice too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking that, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um... Already, onto the trackâ

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um, Gentile-san!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, sorry to interrupt your 
training! There's something I'd like to 
ask you. Could you spare some time later?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...No, right now is fine. Provided you 
keep it under five minutes, that is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Then—how did you manage to beat Orfe-san?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's someone I want to beat no matter 
what! Please let me use this as reference 
for that!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...The reason you ask— is it because you 
lack the confidence to win?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No. I do have confidence. However... I 
really, truly want to win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what it takes, I'll do 
anything. If you're telling me that's the 
very essence of your running— I will adopt 
it completely!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...How adorable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. —Feast your eyes upon this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to Almond Eye, just as 
Gentildonna was about to start running. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hnnngh!!
choice_data_list: (...Ghk, what raw power...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Charging up the uphill slope with 
tremendous power— the height of the flying 
woodchips proved her extraordinary 
muscular strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Build yourself an overwhelming physique.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is sheer, unadulterated 
power—surpassing skill, and even 
experience...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Power is the true path to becoming the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...Physicality. If I had that...—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I have a favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“I want to build overwhelming physical 
strength”... So, using Gentildonna's 
training as a reference, I put together a 
temporary regimen, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, fifty... f-five...! Fifty... 
s-si...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Phaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I couldn't lift the barbell all 
the way...!
choice_data_list: No, no, you really did your best...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's workout consisted of 
extraordinary, high-weight and high-load 
routines. Right now, keeping up with 
her... is physically impossible.
choice_data_list:
It's dangerous, so let's lower the weight 
some more.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Yeah... That's true, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case, isn't there another way to 
put just as much strain on it!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I could get closer to Ms. Gentile's 
kind of power... I truly believe I could 
win no matter how the race unfolds!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hard work doesn't bother me at all! Could 
you redesign the menu for me?
choice_data_list:
(Her determination is overwhelming, but 
still—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then—a thought strikes me. Her mental 
fortitude might actually surpass even 
Gentildonna's.
choice_data_list:
(In that case, the "strength" of Ai's to 
cultivate is—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all for cooperating! You'll 
have to run multiple times today, but... 
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I had gathered 14 Umamusume 
together, including Karen Bouquetd'or.
choice_data_list:
I want each of you to run according to 
your instructions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sent them tactical instruction data in 
advance. This was to identify all possible 
race-day scenarios and simulate them under 
realistic conditions.
choice_data_list:
(I'll verify it with this. Her greatest 
weapon—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
First up is Pattern A... right? I'll play 
Cheval-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as they repeated the simulations 
while switching roles and positions, the 
Umamusume gradually grew more fired up—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Ah, that spot's open! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Gah!?
choice_data_list: (We collided...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye made accidental contact with 
another Umamusume and was pushed toward 
the back...! Yet, in a situation where 
anyone would flinch—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I won't lose! I won't lose! I 
don't wanna lose...! Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...All right! All right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye regained her composure and 
claimed a brilliant victory. As expected, 
her greatest weapon is—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. So that's how it is with that 
girl.”
choice_data_list: Gentil...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile! Were you watching?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I've witnessed your strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—A mental fortitude that surpasses all 
others.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't matter who the opponent is, or 
how the race develops. You express my 
physical capabilities through your heart."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...You truly are adorable.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, you're saying that if 
it's me—I can push through skill and 
experience with pure heart?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're right.
Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, is that all it was?! In that case, 
no use overthinking it!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As long as I run true to myself—it means I 
won't lose to anyone!
choice_data_list: Let's take it with us. —To the Japan Cup

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an incredible lineup again this 
year! You've got the powerhouses who 
clashed fiercely with Kitasan, plus 
Kiseki, who's a total wildcard!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, Almond Eye! I wonder, 
can I measure up to her...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Some girls only shine on the Tiara 
route... you know? But hey, we have 
Gentil's precedent, so... you never know, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The meeting ended long ago. All that's 
left is to send her off.
choice_data_list: All eyes are on you.
All eyes are on you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes. It seems so!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You look like... you're scheming 
something, though?
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to seeing how you win.
I'm looking forward to seeing how you win

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that I can share in the taste of her 
victory... I wonder what path to victory 
her heart will forge when facing such an 
incredible lineup—
choice_data_list:
I can't wait for the moment we cross the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see! In that case, please give me 
just a little more time.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—I'll deliver it at the speed of the 
world's fastest!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, can you feel it? This atmosphere, 
this heat――"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't get enough of this...! I want to 
live up to it—no, I want to shatter all 
expectations! That's why I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I will paint a shocking race, one that no 
one has ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be right at the center of the 
two-page spread. And Ai-chan, you'll—play 
the role of the ultimate rival!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chan...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I have no idea at all. 
What on earth you are thinking.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So I decided not to overthink anything 
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'll just run straight toward victory. 
With just that feeling, I—I will win!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Guided by this heat. —No matter what 
impact comes, I'll surge from behind and 
pass them all!
